entry.title: Source-grounded guide to plugin architecture, task examples, an inspectable local package, policy constraints and dated evidence.
Find developer tasks in architecture, building, testing, security, submission, maintenance and business constraints, with the original research dates and untested limitations.

Run a 19-file offline kit and inspect 33 tooling assertions, an observed packaging failure/repair and finite checker scope. Ten separate host cases are proposed, not tested; a blank record and rubric show what host evidence is still needed.

Distinguish portable source checks from Codex logo/composerIcon compatibility and the public icon requirement before installation. Skills-only URL-import checks do not waive privacy policy; the dated report keeps unresolved documentation conflicts visible.

Compare source, loaded host/session, public package and live backend separately. A runnable offline recorder, same-version edit and nine-change evidence aid show what changed in source; actual host/public/backend state was not tested.

Five primary resources explain source/cache/public/live-MCP boundaries. Endpoint guidance remains conflicting; pending-review retention was unresolved at this dated check. Annotation, catalog, pricing, migration, workspace sync and chronology keep their earlier dates.

See how a fictional SaaS workflow can serve an existing entitlement without directing digital upgrades. Six proposed copy/boundary/next-decision cases and a conditional destination review remain hypothetical and untested, not payment or compliance results.

Compare five primary commerce/auth/security pages. Physical-goods saved-method guidance remains conflicting across guideline/API/UI scope; no source precedence, SaaS exception or enabling was established. No changed rule or release date was established.

Separate private reads, unsaved previews and external sends. Three non-executable contracts and fictional confirmation copy illustrate a fixed-action human-consent boundary and uncertain-outcome stop; the design is untested, not a safety guarantee.

Four primary pages and an annotation-error pairing clarify action metadata, persistence, retries and consent. The annotation conflict remains unresolved at its 4 October scope; endpoint and checkout conflicts retain their 2 and 3 October dates.

A hypothetical repository review separates required policy/input handling from an optional local helper. The dependency sketch and evidence worksheet show why an intended missing-policy stop is not enforced behavior; host execution remains untested.

Five primary sources explain local hook discovery, trust, orchestration and dependencies. This is finer documentary detail, not an established rule change; annotation, endpoint and checkout disagreements retain their 4, 2 and 3 October dates.

Check the public-ZIP gate before adapting a local bundle: lifecycle hooks and registered MCP mappings are excluded by the cited guidance. Local support or optionality is not public eligibility, and removing components does not pass the remaining validation/review requirements.

The core-plus-helper design is conditional local/repository/workspace advice, not public-ZIP eligibility. The conversion guide’s submission-context wording remains in tension with the exclusion; no precedence or exception was established.

Diagnose a missing configured-marketplace Codex CLI skill or tool by separating source/state, selection, current-session capability and useful output. Documented inspection commands and redacted escalation are provided; no root cause or tested repair is claimed.

Before changing an Enterprise web/Chat team GPT entry link, preserve work and check sharing, permissions, recipient installation/selection and familiar output. The proposed controlled-entry handoff is untested, not an automatic redirect or outside/public continuity guarantee.

For public remote-MCP / ChatGPT OAuth, distinguish registration contract, exact callback and provider versus portal clarification. The precise provided-client location was unresolved at this check; the triage is not a diagnosed defect or tested cure.

Locate provided/clientId in the portable named-server configuration and a required application secret in Connect. Advanced settings display source; an edit/upload does not prove saved credentials changed or unlocked. This resolves the documentary location question, not the actual cause or fix.

Choose local preparation or deliberate wait/cancel/replacement while one same-plugin review is active. Keep the current published remote-MCP version during replacement review, then publish the approved replacement directly. Cancellation and appeals differ; actual continuity and review timing were not tested.

A missing directory tile is not a publication diagnosis. Check chosen Publish and the exact publication name or portal-supplied directory URL; main-page placement is discretionary. Keep genuine route/recipient failures actionable. The proposed sequence is untested, not an acquisition or placement remedy.
